labels.contract: REAL staged terms of the White Rock option (Elko County, NV, 2020; catalogue row NV-04): $10,000 at signing, then $25,000, $40,000, $50,000 and $125,000 at years 1-4, no work commitments, 2% NSR, $25,000 annual advance minimum royalty after exercise. Applied HYPOTHETICALLY to a 640-acre claim block inside the Tok Site B window; no such offer exists.
labels.carry: VERIFIED rates (Arjin, research/tok-land/alaska_holding_costs_by_year.csv on arjin/tok-land-data; Alaska session laws 1989 ch. 101 and 2000 ch. 74, DNR Annual Rent fact sheet 11 AAC 86.221). The block is four 160-acre state claims staked 2016-17, so age 6-10: rent 4 x $330 = $1,320 a year, plus annual labour 4 x $400 = $1,600 a year paid in cash instead of work (2000 law; later changes not checked) = $243.33 a month during the option. After exercise the claims are age 11 or more: 4 x $825 + $1,600 = $4,900 a year, plus the $25,000 advance royalty = $2,491.67 a month.
labels.arrival: Staking events = distinct owner-days in the Tok Site B window, 2007-2025, from Alaska DNR state claims (NTPSTDT meaning unconfirmed). 2025 is partial: data end 2025-03-05, so its exposure is 63/365 of a year. The belief forgets old years at a rate chosen by one-step-ahead predictive score (only earlier years), averaged over the grid by those scores. Weak starting prior Gamma(0.5, 0.5 years). q (buyers per staking event) is an ASSUMPTION; the engine reports the q at which the decision flips.
labels.bids: ASSUMED two-point buyer offers for the full block. For scale only: published Alaska claim packages sold for about $170-205/acre (Avidian 2024; US Antimony 2025, an antimony option), i.e. roughly $109k-131k for 640 acres. Not a Tok price.
labels.acceleration: ASSUMPTION: the optionee may pay the remaining stages early to complete a sale when a buyer arrives. Not stated in the White Rock release; the engine reports the value with this assumption reversed.
labels.wait: ASSUMPTION: if we wait 12 months and watch nearby staking, the same terms are still available with probability 0.5. The engine reports the probability at which waiting beats buying now.
labels.swarm: Tok society results from swarm/score.py report (branch ahmed/gold-society-plan). Used only for scenarios whose pre-registered checks pass, mapped to engine inputs by the labelled assumptions in swarm-mappings.json.

counterparty.evidence: 20 of 34 Site B samples sit inside active state claims, 17 held by Contango Minerals Alaska (Arjin, research/tok-land/site-b/summary.md); a holder exists to grant an option.

land_status.evidence: State land status codes at Site B samples (PA 26, TA 1, RL 1) are not explained by DNR; BLM federal and Native corporation land were not checked (BLM Alaska service down).

mineral_rights_conveyed.evidence: No agreement exists; what an option would convey (claims only, surface excluded) must be confirmed against the instrument.
